description.text: A special Sun & Moon set of 78 cards, released on 6 October 2017 and sold only in collections and boxes, never in booster boxes, with a foil card in every pack. It brought back Shining Pokémon, last seen in Neo Destiny more than fifteen years before, with six of them, among them Shining Jirachi and Shining Volcanion, beside Legendary and Mythical Pokémon such as Zekrom, Latios, Mewtwo-GX and Entei-GX. It was the second set sold this way, after Generations.
